slice.label: Subdomain slice inside the context, dash-case (e.g. invoicing)

resource.label: REST resource the route hangs from, dash-case; becomes the controller path and file base (e.g. invoices gives invoices.controller.ts under /api/invoices)

path.label: Path under the resource (default: /); needed only when the resource has several rows for the method

description: Nest controller operation for one use case, read from its row in the Driving adapters table of domain-model.md (route, use case, success status: the first 2xx of Answers), inside the slice's infrastructure/http/<resource>.controller.ts (infrastructure is the ring where Nest decorators live). Request input is Zod schema-first: @Body({ schema }), @Query({ schema }) and @Param({ schema }) feed the global StandardSchemaValidationPipe; the use case is injected by its Symbol token. Registers the controller in the slice's composition.ts and the context module in apps/api AppModule. Run again with the same resource to add another operation to the same controller. The use case must already be exported by the barrel (hex-use-case).
